en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard. The front shows a multi‑storey brick building with green shutters and a terrace set in a wooded area, with many tables and chairs arranged outdoors like a garden restaurant. Hungarian caption text is printed along the bottom. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, a green Hungarian postage stamp, a circular postal cancellation, and an address section.
